global-city-vi.tagline: Villa and open plots at Rudraram, on the Mumbai Highway (NH-65)
heroIntro: HMDA-approved villa and open plots on 21 acres 10 guntas at Rudraram, on the Mumbai Highway (NH-65) near GITAM University.
Global City VI is a gated layout of 288 plots from 147 to 731 sq yd, with 40 ft and 30 ft CC roads, a clubhouse with a swimming pool, and a 100 ft road on its frontage.

faq.a: Yes. HMDA issued the final layout permit 2046/HMDA/SWFL/2026 on 23 Apr 2026. The brochure's layout copy carries HMDA LP 007133/LO/HMDA/1700/SKP/2024 dated 28 Nov 2024. The project is registered with TS RERA under P01100009270, which you can check on rera.telangana.gov.in.
The layout has 288 plots from 147 to 731 sq yd, most of them under 300 sq yd, almost all facing east or west, on 40 ft and 30 ft CC roads. Ask us which sizes and facings are open today.

faq.q: Can I get a bank loan for a plot?
faq.a: Bank loans are available, as the project brochure states, and the titles are clear. We can share the documents your bank will ask for.

faq.q: How do I visit the site?
faq.a: Use Schedule site visit at the bottom of the page and our sales team calls you back (office hours Wed – Mon, 10:00 – 18:00 IST). We arrange the visit at a time that suits you.

faq.q: Do you build villas on the plots?
faq.a: Yes, on request. The brochure shows an east-facing and a west-facing villa design for this layout; once you have chosen a plot we can take you through construction.

faq.q: Can NRIs buy a plot here?
faq.a: Yes. Indian rules allow NRIs and OCI cardholders to buy residential plots. We share the documents, site photos and plot details by email, and can show the site to family members in Hyderabad.
